subject: ROOT-CAUSE CANDIDATE + CLAIM nord2_metal_bridge.c (B2 ring only: jm_submit ring insert + wait_handles_impl + n2mb_open env read)
body: B2 targeted-wait ring (C6q) is undersized for the P15 kernel: bridge recent[64] comment assumes 'kernel holds at most 32 jobs'; P15 kernel (f604e06) N2C_CTX_JOBS=96 per context, N2C_MAX_JOBS=128 (C6p-era header: 32). Bridge reaps only on waits, so 65..96 unreaped jobs is normal with async+targeted waits; backboardd commands exceed 64 jobs. A job evicted from the ring is invisible to n2mb_wait_handles: a mid-command CPU blit (texture upload, mipmap gen blit==4, readback), re-expansion, preclear or shadow refresh then proceeds while that older job still reads/writes the buffer -> broken textures/icons. Not affected by the 4 disabled features or n2resv=0. FIX (minimal, claim now, ~20 lines): track the newest job id evicted from the ring (recent_lost); wait_handles waits at least to it when > reaped (exact, in-order), ring 128; env NORD2_METAL_WAIT_HANDLES=0 / -DN2MB_WAIT_HANDLES_DEFAULT=0 makes wait_handles a full wait_pending (device bisect switch). Will not touch pooling/code cache/site code. Regression test in gpu/tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c (append-only).
